annotations.title: How much of my balance is really mine?

description: Rough safe-to-spend number: takes the bank balance shown in the app and subtracts bills due before the next payday, card charges not yet paid off, and money already set aside. Use when someone asks how much they can actually spend until payday. Balance may be negative (overdrawn).

balance.description: Balance the bank app shows, in US dollars. Negative if overdrawn.

bills_before_payday.description: Bills due before the next payday (rent, phone, insurance).

card_charges.description: Card charges not paid off yet.

set_aside.description: Money already set aside for something.

name: safe_to_spend
title: How much of my balance is really mine?
